campaign: Complete integrated platform validation, then transfer audio.cpp capabilities through one native train-evaluate-serve proof and expand the shared audio substrate
doctrine: The retained integrated-validation rows remain the capability-freeze prerequisite and run before audio implementation; this branch does not evade or discard open master obligations. After they complete, audio.cpp is a pinned behavioral oracle and mechanism source, never a linked runtime, hosted server, package manager, or permanent product dependency. The transfer unit is a verified processing capability: source commit, license and artifact identity, neutral typed contract, intermediate golden traces, Go CPU reference, manifest-owned CUDA where measurement justifies it, recipe-selected consumer, evaluation evidence, and deletion of temporary comparison adapters. ASR is first because Overgo already serves and trains speech synthesis but lacks a first-class transcription lifecycle. The first elected model is a compact CTC-capable artifact selected from the pinned census by runnable artifact availability, traceability, architectural reuse, memory, and wall cost; no family name enters shared executors. Forward parity precedes backward implementation, while task, artifact, state, and checkpoint contracts retain the information required for gradients, deterministic replay, trainable-parameter selection, and optimizer state. The campaign is not complete when inference runs: its proof is a recorded audio dataset entering native training, exact stop and resume preserving optimizer, random and data-stream state, a pre/post WER bracket, and the resulting checkpoint serving through the authenticated API with complete OvergoDB lineage. CPU is the numerical authority. CUDA enters only through kernels/manifest.json and must match the CPU contract on the same artifact and fixtures. Streaming work owns bounded sessions, cancellation, chunk-boundary invariance, finalization, and backpressure. Every quality or performance claim names its artifact, dataset, environment, denominator, latency, throughput, host memory and VRAM. Later ASR, VAD, alignment, diarization, voice and generative-audio rows stay behind the first closed-loop proof so breadth cannot hide an incomplete lifecycle. Findings outside this scope are recorded but do not expand the campaign.

steps.title: Run the host race lane and CUDA racecheck/synccheck
steps.rationale: Missing compiler, device, driver, or sanitizer reports UNAVAILABLE explicitly rather than passing silently. The device lane is green on this machine; the host lane needs the llvm-mingw toolchain installed at .tools/llvm-mingw, an external download awaiting owner authorization, so the row sits after the drills that can run now.

items.title: End-to-end inference over the verified artifact matrix

steps.title: Serve the verified matrix -- Qwen3 dense text and quantized CUDA, Qwen3.5 hybrid execution with MTP speculation, Gemma3 text, Gemma4 multimodal projection, T5 encoder, and one media-generation recipe -- measuring output correctness, buffered and streaming parity, native, OpenAI-style, and Anthropic-style protocol parity, time to first token, tokens per second, peak host memory and VRAM, prompt-cache reuse, context shifting, and speculative decoding on versus off
steps.rationale: The smoke matrix is the servable predicate over the store, judged against verified models rather than all prototypes; perf-sweep and perplexity supply the per-model measurements. Bind the exact matrix invocation via -setverify once installed model identities are captured.

steps.title: Exercise concurrent scheduling, live model swap through the proxy, restart continuation, and download cancellation with clean server shutdown
steps.rationale: These are the operational paths a single-model serve never touches; each has a gated suite under the device and server lanes. Bind the combined invocation via -setverify when the drill starts.

items.title: End-to-end training beyond a successful update step

steps.title: For every declared training route: load exact recorded input, train through the declared architecture route, publish checkpoint and optimizer state, stop and resume exactly, verify data-stream and random-state continuity, reload the checkpoint, run post-training inference, evaluate the pre/post bracket, and confirm frozen components remain unchanged
steps.rationale: train-lane is the store-derived training matrix through the same workflow a user runs; exact resume and frozen-component invariance are where training verification usually lies. Dense token training requires -freeze-lexical or the host Newton-Schulz path stalls at zero GPU utilization.

steps.title: Exercise DPO and GRPO with valid objective-specific inputs and evaluate their brackets
steps.rationale: Preference objectives need inputs a smoke cannot supply; this drill provides them explicitly rather than skipping the routes.

steps.title: Execute the pinned benchmark set with each model's declared conversation framing: a broad knowledge suite such as MMLU-Pro, TruthfulQA, IFEval, sequence likelihood or perplexity, retrieval quality, and multimodal evaluation where applicable
steps.rationale: evaluate -all derives models and suites from the store; results publish through benchmark -publish into the evidence picker with denominators.

steps.title: Run throughput and memory sweeps and judge every quality/resource pair through the exact multidimensional improvement-fitness owner
steps.rationale: A throughput gain that reduces quality, or a quality gain that violates memory bounds, must not pass; the fitness owner landed in 45bb65f9 and this drill consumes it. Bind the sweep matrix and the loop -compare-resource-fitness invocation via -setverify when the drill starts.

steps.title: Run counterfactual routing replay, rollout projection, and safety-window derivation over the recorded router observations
steps.rationale: Routing quality is only measurable against the recorded stream; replay keeps the judgment exact and distribution-honest. Bind the replay invocation via -setverify when the drill starts.

steps.title: Interrupt generation and training mid-flight, interrupt checkpoint publication, recover a torn store tail, and run compaction and restore on the damaged copy
steps.rationale: Interruption is the one input every durable subsystem claims to survive; each drill damages a copy, never the canonical store, and store-check is the verdict.

steps.title: Exercise circuit-breaker escalation, candidate quarantine and re-entry, rollback to the predecessor recipe, peer timeout and partial response, and workflow restart with persistent obligations
steps.rationale: The control plane's refusal and recovery paths are capability claims like any other; each has an evidence door under cmd/loop and cmd/agent-loop. Bind the drill sequence via -setverify when it starts.

steps.title: Interrupt a gate run against a scratch clone and recover through -recover-preparation, -recover-interrupted, and the watchdog
steps.rationale: The gate is the most state-bearing process in the repository -- plan mutation, commit, and store writes in one transaction -- and its recovery paths deserve the same drill as checkpoints. Bind the scripted drill via -setverify when it starts.

items.title: Pin the audio.cpp oracle and elect the first transferable artifact

steps.title: Create a deterministic audio.cpp census covering source commit, licenses, model specifications, loaders, artifact formats, preprocessing, execution graphs, streaming state, training relevance, tests, and known incomplete implementations
steps.rationale: The census prevents model-list breadth from substituting for runnable behavior and makes provenance, unsupported paths, and reusable mechanisms machine-checkable. It imports neutral evidence only and introduces no cross-repository runtime dependency.

steps.title: Elect and register one compact CTC ASR artifact with complete bytes, tokenizer, configuration, reference execution, and license, preferring Granite ASR only if the census and installed artifacts support it
steps.rationale: Artifact availability and executable evidence decide the first model; a remembered family preference does not. The election records rejected candidates and the measurements that would reopen the choice.

items.title: Generalize Overgo's typed audio and recipe contracts

steps.title: Add neutral contracts for transcription, timestamped alignment, speech turns, activity segments, converted audio and generated audio while deriving sample rate, channels, encoding, frame geometry, context and state from artifacts
steps.rationale: The existing fixed text-to-speech pipeline cannot represent audio-to-text or streaming state. Shared contracts describe behavior and representations without embedding an elected model family or an inference-only shortcut.

steps.title: Define bounded audio stream sessions with explicit chunk state, overlap, backpressure, cancellation, finalization, discontinuity and restart semantics
steps.rationale: Streaming correctness is a state-machine contract, not repeated offline calls. Ownership must prove bounded goroutine and buffer lifetimes before a network route consumes it.

items.title: Port the shared CPU audio frontend with oracle parity

steps.title: Implement artifact-derived resampling, framing, windowing, STFT and inverse STFT, filterbanks, log-mel features, normalization and chunk assembly in Go with reusable scratch ownership
steps.rationale: These primitives are the reusable substrate for ASR, VAD, speaker encoders, codecs and generative audio. Constants come from artifact declarations or mathematical identities, not family-specific call sites.

steps.title: Capture and verify hashed intermediate traces from the pinned oracle at waveform, resample, frame, spectrum, filterbank and normalized-feature boundaries
steps.rationale: Final transcripts alone cannot localize numerical drift. Boundary traces bind the source commit, artifact bytes, fixture bytes, shapes, tolerances and observed errors.

items.title: Deliver the first native CPU ASR capability

steps.title: Load the elected artifact and implement its encoder, CTC projection, tokenizer and deterministic decoder through neutral execution owners
steps.rationale: The CPU path is the numerical authority. Loader mappings, tensor shapes, intermediate activations, logits, token IDs and final text all require parity evidence against the pinned oracle.

steps.title: Compile and execute audio to features to encoder to transcript as a native model recipe with complete artifact lineage
steps.rationale: A package-level forward pass is not an Overgo capability until the recipe compiler, runtime and store own its inputs, outputs, resources and provenance.

items.title: Make audio quality and resource fitness native evidence

steps.title: Add pinned transcription evaluation with normalization provenance, WER, CER, utterance counts, duration, failure accounting and grouped slices
steps.rationale: The trainer needs a quality bracket whose denominator and normalization are stable. Aggregate WER without failed-utterance accounting or slices can conceal regressions.

steps.title: Record offline and chunked real-time factor, first-partial latency, finalization latency, host memory, VRAM and transcript quality through multidimensional fitness
steps.rationale: Faster audio that loses words or violates memory bounds does not pass. Every measurement binds the same model, dataset, code, environment and execution policy.

items.title: Expose authenticated transcription and streaming through the native server

steps.title: Implement OpenAI-compatible POST /v1/audio/transcriptions with typed native parity, explicit supported formats, bounded uploads, cancellation and recorded recipe execution
steps.rationale: The route must use the same authenticated workspace, artifact, recipe and operation owners as existing APIs. It does not inherit audio.cpp's server or model-management surface.

steps.title: Serve partial and final transcripts through the bounded session contract and prove chunk-boundary invariance, backpressure, disconnect cancellation and clean shutdown
steps.rationale: Network streaming must not create an unbounded goroutine, queue or retained audio path. Offline and streaming results are compared under declared chunk and finalization semantics.

items.title: Accelerate the elected ASR model through manifest-owned CUDA

steps.title: Profile the CPU recipe, reuse existing kernels where their contracts match, and add only measured missing operators through the kernel manifest and generated ABI
steps.rationale: CUDA surface follows measured time and operator contracts. Model-specific kernels or hand-written ABI paths are refused when an existing manifest operator can serve the shape.

steps.title: Prove CPU and CUDA parity for intermediate activations, logits, decoded transcripts and WER, then record wall, real-time factor, host memory and VRAM
steps.rationale: A device-unavailable result is not passing evidence. The CUDA route becomes eligible only when the same artifact and fixtures preserve quality within recorded tolerances.

items.title: Prove Overgo's universal trainer on the native audio route

steps.title: Register and materialize a pinned speech dataset as waveform, transcript and derived-feature training records with deterministic splits, resumable stream position and complete source lineage
steps.rationale: Training begins from the same typed audio and artifact contracts as inference. Split membership, transformations and stream position must survive restart exactly.

steps.title: Implement CTC loss and backward execution for the elected graph, beginning with frozen-component or adapter training and checking every new gradient against finite differences or an independent oracle
steps.rationale: Backward support follows proven forward operators. Frozen selection and trainable parameter ownership are explicit, and every gradient-bearing operator receives direct numerical evidence.

steps.title: Interrupt and resume native ASR training while preserving parameters, optimizer, random, scheduler and data-stream state, then prove the resumed trajectory matches uninterrupted execution
steps.rationale: A loadable weight file is not exact resume. The comparison covers the next batch identity, loss, parameter update and optimizer state after restart.

steps.title: Train or adapt the elected ASR artifact, evaluate a pre/post WER and resource bracket, publish the checkpoint, reload it, and serve it through /v1/audio/transcriptions with end-to-end OvergoDB lineage
steps.rationale: This is the campaign's primary product proof: one system owns dataset, training, exact resume, evaluation, artifact publication and serving. Improvement is accepted only through the recorded multidimensional fitness owner, not a selected example transcript.

items.title: Prove the substrate with a second ASR architecture and live operations

steps.title: Port a second materially different ASR architecture, preferring Qwen ASR only when its artifact and oracle path are complete, while reusing the same frontend, task, evaluation, serving and training contracts
steps.rationale: A second real consumer proves the abstraction and exposes family leakage. Shared executors remain neutral; architecture facts stay in the recipe and artifact declarations.

steps.title: Exercise concurrent transcription, resource-aware placement, live model switching, restart recovery and cancellation across both ASR artifacts
steps.rationale: The second model must participate in Overgo's operational system rather than creating a separate audio runtime. The smoke matrix is derived from verified servable artifacts in the store.

items.title: Expand shared speech analysis after the ASR lifecycle is proven

steps.title: Port one compact voice-activity detector with offline and streaming parity and consume its segments in the transcription recipe
steps.rationale: VAD is the smallest second consumer of the frontend and stream contracts and can remove measured wasted ASR work without introducing a second scheduler.

steps.title: Add timestamped alignment and speaker-turn diarization with native evaluation for boundary error, attribution error and transcript preservation
steps.rationale: Alignment and diarization consume typed transcripts, features and stream segments. They land only with quality metrics and artifact lineage, not as unscored postprocessing.

items.title: Consolidate speech synthesis and admit broader audio generation

steps.title: Migrate PocketTTS inference and training onto the shared audio artifacts, sessions, evaluation and lifecycle contracts without regressing its existing compatibility evidence
steps.rationale: Existing speech synthesis is the first consolidation consumer. The migration deletes displaced TTS-only policy instead of maintaining parallel audio lifecycles.

steps.title: Elect and port one additional audio.cpp voice capability such as multilingual TTS or voice conversion through the shared codec, speaker and training contracts
steps.rationale: The elected capability must provide complete artifact and oracle evidence. Incomplete or documentation-only audio.cpp implementations are ineligible regardless of prominence.

steps.title: Run a bounded election and forward-parity probe for one music or general-audio diffusion capability, reusing Overgo's DiT, media evaluation and training infrastructure
steps.rationale: Generative audio is admitted only after speech proves the lifecycle and a bounded probe shows reusable operators, executable artifacts, quality assertions and a credible training route. The probe closes without production surface when those conditions fail.
